signal_rules.impact_copy: Cloudier water can reduce intake quality quickly and disrupt filtration-heavy sites.
Oxygen stress can affect retention basins and waterfront operations before the issue is visible citywide.
Rapid water chemistry shifts can affect direct intake, clinic kitchens, and sensitive refill points.
